proposals.before: Zhang Qian's grandson Sun Meng, styled Ziyou, was a brilliant man who rose to grand counsellor under Emperor Yuan, served on the Xiongnu embassy staff, sat in the inner court, and fell to Shi Xian's slander.
proposals.after: Zhang Qian's grandson Meng, styled Ziyou, was a brilliant man who rose to grand counsellor under Emperor Yuan, served on the Xiongnu embassy staff, sat in the inner court, and fell to Shi Xian's slander.

proposals.before: On his return Zhang Qian was appointed grand coachman.

proposals.reason: 大行 is the Han guest/diplomatic office (later dahonglu), not “grand coachman.”

proposals.before: Army Rectifier Zhao Shi, who had piled up the greatest merit, became grand counsellor of the palace;
proposals.after: Army Rectifier Zhao Shicheng, who had piled up the greatest merit, became grand counsellor of the palace;

proposals.after: the army rectifier Zhao Shicheng had the most merit and was made grand counsellor of the palace;
proposals.reason: 趙始成 is the personal name; 功最多 means “had the most merit,” not part of the name or “merit in success.”
